sva: p_no_spurious_gnt0: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) gnt0 |-> req0);
intent_summary: Grant 0 should only assert when request 0 is active.

sva: p_no_spurious_gnt1: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) gnt1 |-> req1);
intent_summary: Grant 1 should only assert when request 1 is active.

sva: p_mutex: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) !(gnt0 && gnt1));
intent_summary: The arbiter must not grant both clients in the same cycle.
